sections.title: 1) General Information
paras: Parties: Contractor — Sole Proprietor Shagidov F.T.; Customer — any individual.
Form: public offer; concluded by adhesion (acceptance without reservations).
Subject: paid access to the service for generating music, images and songs via the websites Vokalo.kg / Vokalo.ru / Vokalo.online.
Legal basis: Civil Code of the Kyrgyz Republic (incl. Arts. 386, 387, 395, 398, 399, etc.).
Placement: the text is published on Vokalo.kg, Vokalo.ru, Vokalo.online.

sections.title: 2) Terms
paras: Website — the websites at the stated addresses.
Personal Account — protected pages accessible by email+password (authentication data).
Invoice — invoice/bill/price agreement protocol, etc., determining the price and, if necessary, the payment procedure.

sections.title: 3) Conclusion and Access Provision
paras: The Agreement is public; publishing the text constitutes an offer.
Acceptance: payment for services (including when paid with credit funds — concluding a credit agreement with the bank).
From the moment of acceptance the Parties are deemed to have concluded the Agreement in writing.
After acceptance, the Contractor provides access to the service.

sections.title: 4) Contractor’s Duties and Rights
paras: Duties:
— Provide access to the service.
— Provide information support on business days 09:00–18:00 (until 17:00 on Friday/shortened days); contact: {{email}}.
— Fix errors/defects at own expense.
— Process refunds in the established cases/conditions.
Rights:
— Modify the service.
— Engage/replace third parties without approval.
— Request necessary information/documents.
— Change pricing (current prices — on the Website).
— Temporarily suspend the Website for maintenance/repairs.

sections.title: 5) Customer’s Duties and Rights
paras: Duties:
— Pay fully and on time.
— Provide accurate data (incl. during registration).
— Use access exclusively for personal/non‑commercial purposes.
— Keep login/password confidential and notify of unauthorized access.
— Do not publish others’ personal data; do not register on behalf of others/legal entities; do not disrupt the site; do not use malware/scripts without permission.
Rights:
— Obtain access after meeting the conditions.
— Receive information support throughout the Agreement term.
— Use access only for non‑commercial purposes.
— Submit comments/suggestions/feedback.

sections.title: 6) Price and Payment
paras: Pricing currency: Kyrgyz som; price — per Website or per Invoice.
Payment: 100% prepayment in a single transfer to the settlement account (unless otherwise specified in the Invoice); the payment date is when funds are credited to the Contractor’s account.
Payment methods — those supported by the Contractor; current list — on the Website/by other means. Detailed rules — Appendix No. 1.
Payment on credit — under the bank’s terms; the Contractor is not a lender and is not liable for the bank’s terms/refusal.
The date of service/goods provision is the date access is granted; from this date the service/goods are deemed provided.

sections.title: 7) Liability and Limitations
paras: Customer’s penalty for violation: 5000 KGS per each violation (out‑of‑court upon written demand).
In case of violation: deactivation of Personal Account/blocking access without refund; obligation to pay default interest within 15 calendar days from notification.
The Contractor is not liable for:
— content in user chats (WhatsApp/Viber/Telegram) and use of personal data there;
— Internet connection quality/equipment of the Customer;
— the Customer’s equipment not meeting requirements (if any);
— services not matching expectations (subjective opinion is not a quality criterion);
— the Customer’s errors when using the Website’s functionality;
— the choice/use of payment method and consequences;
— actions of banks/third parties in settlements/refunds.
Uninterrupted Website operation is not guaranteed; no liability for ISP failures/Internet access restrictions and other matters beyond the Contractor’s control.
Force majeure: natural disasters, strikes, wars, epidemics/pandemics, etc.

If the Customer fails to perform (incl. under cl. 4.2): unilateral out‑of‑court termination by the Contractor upon email notice; the Agreement terminates on the date of sending or within the stated term; access is deactivated.

sections.title: 8) IP and Confidentiality
paras: Access is granted to the Contractor’s/third parties’ IP (software, audiovisual materials, LMS, guides, assignments, information resources, etc.).
The Customer must:
— not copy/record/reproduce/replicate/distribute/modify/create derivatives without written permission;
— report IP infringements;
— not share credentials with third parties; in case of loss/unauthorized access — immediately notify {{email}}; until notification all actions are deemed made by the Customer.
Confidential Information: any service‑related information not publicly available; do not disclose without written consent.
The Contractor may use objects created by the Customer while studying materials and may mention the Customer as a user/client.

Additional consents: to personal data processing (per the Website’s Policy); to use of reviews (without full name and without image; adaptations allowed without distorting meaning; valid until consent is withdrawn); to receive advertising/information messages (email, phone, messengers Viber/Telegram/WhatsApp, postal mail, SMS, push, calls).

sections.title: 9) Miscellaneous
paras: The Customer confirms legal capacity and required age.
Service may be refused if: the bank/payment system does not confirm payment authorization; a refund is initiated; other statutory/contractual grounds.
Term: from acceptance until obligations are fulfilled.
The Contractor may amend terms/add new terms/appendices without prior notice; continued use equals consent.
Texts of amendments/new editions are published on the Website.
Customer’s silence (no written objections, incl. on tariffs) = consent and accession to the new edition.
Termination: by mutual agreement; or unilateral termination by either Party upon notice via Personal Account/email at least 15 calendar days before termination date.
Invalidity of a clause does not invalidate the rest.
Governing law — laws of the Kyrgyz Republic.

Disputes: negotiations → courts of the Kyrgyz Republic, with mandatory pre‑trial procedure (a claim is sent in a way that identifies the sender and delivery; returned mail due to absence of recipient does not prevent filing a lawsuit; response to a claim — 10 business days; lack of response = consent to the claim).
Electronic documents sent electronically/through the Personal Account have legal force.

appendix.title: Appendix No. 1 — Payment and Refund Rules
paras: Payment: final price — per selected plan/service. Non‑cash payment via methods supported on the Website/Personal Account. Accepted: VISA, MasterCard, ELKART, and e‑wallets.
Payments follow Visa/MasterCard rules with confidentiality/security (checks, encryption, secure channels).

Process: 1) Choose ‘Pay by bank card’ → ‘Pay’. 2) Redirect to a secure payment page of the operator/bank; 3‑D Secure is used. 3) Enter card details: number, cardholder name, expiry date, CVV2/CVC2; a special password may be required (MasterCard SecureCode / Verified by Visa).
Card data are not stored on the Contractor’s server/Website; confidentiality is ensured by the PSP/bank; disclosure to third parties only as required by law.
Possible payment refusal reasons: the card is not enabled for online payments; insufficient funds; incorrect details; expired card.
If debiting occurred due to errors but without PSP/bank authorization — the PSP/bank (not the Contractor) performs the refund.
Refunds — grounds: the service/goods were not provided on time due to the Contractor’s fault; the Customer sent a termination/refund notice before the service began; other cases per these Rules.
Refund procedure: a written request to {{email}} followed by sending the original to: Kyrgyz Republic, Bishkek, Usenbaeva St. 138a, apt. 6. The Contractor may require a prescribed request form.
Refund amount: 100% — if cancellation occurs before service/goods are provided (except credit payments; see below for credit).
For payments made with credit funds — refund is made to the bank, less the fees retained by the bank from the Contractor; the Customer’s loan interest is not reimbursed.
50% — if cancellation occurs within 30 calendar days from the date of service/goods provision (for credit — refund to the bank minus fees; interest is not reimbursed).
0% — if cancellation occurs after 30 days from the date of service/goods provision.
Refund timing: to the original payment account, up to 30 days from receipt of the request (actual timing depends on the card‑issuing bank).

If the Customer’s payment details changed or payment was by credit — the Customer must provide current bank details for the refund; if not provided, the Contractor is not liable for incorrect/late refund.
Clarification: for ‘credit’ purchases, all amounts/expenses are calculated from the amount actually received by the Contractor from the bank.
